text:
sara-cs: Hey team — PellaCorp opened a Sev2: after an IdP attribute change some users who were recently provisioned via SCIM ended up with the wrong product role (viewer) even though they belong to the `PellaAdmins` Okta group which should map to `admin`. They say it started after a SAML attr rename.

dan-eng: Do we have an example SCIM group push and the user payload that failed? any 4xx/5xx in the push logs? :eyes:

sara-cs: pasted the push log they sent (redacted):
```
POST /scim/v2/Groups/00g1abcd1234/members
200 OK
payload: {
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"john.doe@example.com","display":"John Doe"},{"value":"jane.smith@example.com","display":"Jane Smith"}]}
  ]
}
```

Note: earlier we saw member payloads with `value` as an opaque `externalId` uuid — now it's email strings.

okta-bot: SCIM Push processed: request_id=610c-xyz status=200 elapsed=132ms

alex-se: This looks like a claim priority / profile mapping regression on Okta's side. They changed the group push mapping to use `user.email` as the member identifier instead of the `user.externalId` attribute we had relied on. Our group->role mapping engine keys off member `externalId` for deterministic role assignment. When the externalId is missing we fall back to email lookup which only matches if the user exists and matches exactly; if not matched we create a placeholder membership that resolves to the default role (viewer) until reconciliation.

mike-pm: So two questions: 1) why did fallback assign viewer instead of preserving existing admin mapping? 2) can we run a reconciliation that will re-apply the admin role for these users?

dan-eng: Answer to (1): our SCIM merge logic currently treats email-only group adds as non-authoritative for role grants if externalId-based mapping is configured. That prevents accidental elevation when emails collide. It does mean a config change on the IdP side can result in a temporary downgrade until a full reconcile. We debated this behavior previously but it's the safer default.

alex-se: For (2): yes — there are two remediation paths. Short-term: run a targeted role-fix script that re-assigns role by matching user email -> set role=admin. Example internal command (ops only):
```
# one-off (requires admin API key)
curl -s -X POST https://console.redwood.example.internal/admin/scim/assign-role
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"emails":["john.doe@example.com","jane.smith@example.com"],"role":"admin","reason":"post-idp-attr-rename fix"}'
```
This will reassign roles immediately.

infra-sre: Long-term fix we should recommend to customer: change Okta group push mapping to include the `externalId` claim (or set the member `value` to the stable UUID) so our SCIM ops sees the canonical id. Okta mapping UI: Profile -> Transformations -> Group Push -> set member value to `user.externalId` (or `user.employeeNumber` if that's stable). We can share a prebuilt mapping snippet.

alex-se: Also adding an internal improvement ticket: fallback path should emit a high-severity telemetry event and mark group-sync delta as needing manual reconciliation; currently it's quiet which made triage slower. Will open ENG-INT-678.

sara-cs: I'm going to coordinate with PellaCorp's Okta admin to update the group push mapping. I'll also schedule the one-off role-fix during their maintenance window tonight and run the reconcile `dry_run` first.

mike-pm: Thanks — please include steps for the customer if they want to self-fix: 1) restore claim to externalId, 2) re-push groups, 3) or run our console "Reconcile SCIM group members" job (Console -> Admin -> SCIM -> Reconcile). We'll provide screenshots.

dan-eng: Note for support runbook: add snippet to detect when group member `value` looks like an email instead of uuid and auto-surface in support UI with suggested remediation.

sara-cs: Will do. I'll DM logs and the exact affected user list to dan-eng and alex-se. Marking this thread follow-up: assign to alex-se for telemetry change, dan-eng for runbook, sara-cs for customer coordination. :white_check_mark:

okta-bot: Incident note: customer updated Okta mapping at 2026-03-16T22:08:00Z (their timezone).
